description: An operational procedure, written to be run at 3am: YAML frontmatter built key by key, an owner/severity meta line, a 'When to use this' abstract callout, the one step people skip highlighted in a danger callout, a preflight task list, phases of numbered steps — each step an h3 with an optional fenced code block, an 'Expect' h4 and footnote refs — separated by `---` rules, rollback folded into a collapsed warning callout, an escalation pipe table, an error-budget formula as a $$ math block, the postmortem lesson as a plain blockquote with its link, a 'See also' wikilink cloud and object-keyed footnotes. Section headings, callout kinds and callout titles belong to the template; write values only. The template does all layout; strings hold text, not markup — except that `voice: true` fields may carry constrained inline formatting (**, *, ~~ on words the reply added, code spans quoting the input, allowlisted emoji within the tone's budget).

service.role: service or system name; frontmatter `service`, and the page heading when `title` is absent

title.role: page heading and frontmatter `title`; falls back to `service` via ??

owner.role: owning team's page name, rendered as an [[owner]] wikilink in the meta line. Name only a page that exists; an invented name is a dangling wikilink

severity.role: the severity this runbook answers to; frontmatter `severity`, rendered as inline code in the meta line

last_reviewed.role: last review date, YYYY-MM-DD; frontmatter `last_reviewed` and the meta line

summary.role: when to reach for this runbook, 2-4 sentences, single paragraph, body of the 'When to use this' abstract callout

danger.role: the one step people skip, a rendered highlight inside the 'Do not skip' danger callout

preflight.role: checks to run before touching anything, one task item each, under 'Before you start'

phases.role: the procedure, one h2 each; `---` thematic breaks separate phases

name.role: phase name, one line, h2 heading

steps.role: the steps of this phase, in order

do.role: what to do, imperative, one line, h3 heading

command.role: the exact command or query to run, one fenced code block

lang.role: fence language for `command`; falls back to sh

expect.role: what success looks like, one paragraph under the 'Expect' h4

note.role: key into `notes`; renders a [^key] footnote ref after the step heading. Must match a `notes` key exactly

rollback.role: how to undo it, one numbered step each, folded into the collapsed 'Rollback' warning callout

escalation.role: rows of the 'Escalation' pipe table; the header (who | when | how) is fixed in the template. `who` is the contact, `when` the trigger, `how` the channel. No | or newlines in values

slo_target.role: availability target, e.g. 99.9%; rendered bold in 'Service level' (shown only when `error_budget` is also present)

error_budget.role: error-budget formula as a TeX expression, rendered as a $$ math block in 'Service level' (shown only when `slo_target` is also present)

lesson.role: one verbatim line from the postmortem that motivated this runbook; a plain blockquote under 'Why this exists'

postmortem_url.role: postmortem URL (http/https); the 'Postmortem' link after the lesson quote

related.role: names of existing site pages; rendered as [[wikilinks]] in frontmatter `related` and the 'See also' link cloud. Name only pages that exist; an invented name is a dangling wikilink

notes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: definitions. Keys are short kebab-case labels. Every key must be referenced by some step `note`, and every `note` must be a key here; format_check flags strays. As a ratchet step the server picks the key and the step it attaches to; write the note text only, copied verbatim from a source
